recipe.build:
rm -rf .git
chmod +x gradlew
PROF_FILE=app/build/intermediates/binary_art_profile/release/compileReleaseArtProfile/baseline.prof
PROF_SHA1=f83f38feefdba3debc2aab3e9bd14e79ca053fdd
for _ in {1..10}; do
./gradlew clean assembleRelease --no-build-cache --no-configuration-cache --no-daemon
test -f "$PROF_FILE"
if [ "$( sha1sum "$PROF_FILE" | cut -d' ' -f1 )" = "$PROF_SHA1" ]; then
break
fi
done
git clone -b v0.3.0 https://github.com/obfusk/reproducible-apk-tools.git
OUT=app/build/outputs/apk/release/de.buttercookie.simbadroid-*-release-unsigned.apk
reproducible-apk-tools/inplace-fix.py --internal --page-size 4 fix-newlines $OUT 'META-INF/services/*'
mv $OUT /outputs/unsigned.apk
